brief:
Raji Sourani, director of the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights, received the Jesús Vicente Chamorro Human Rights Award on October 24 at the 40th Congress of Spain's Progressive Union of Prosecutors in Granada, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The award recognizes his work defending Palestinian rights.

The ceremony took place during the UPF congress, an annual gathering of Spain's progressive prosecutors.

title: Palestinian rights director wins Spanish human rights award
